prompt: We waited in the lobby with our suitcases. "Your shuttle bus is outside," the receptionist (say / tell) a minute ago. Then he (say / tell) us the driver would help with the bags.
explanation_ru: В прямой речи без дополнения используется said; с личным местоимением us используется told.

prompt: Maya walked out of the manager's office smiling. I could (say / tell) from her face that she got the promotion. Later, she (say / tell) that the team was expanding.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение can tell from означает «понять/увидеть по»; перед придаточным с that без адресата ставится said.

prompt: The comedian looked nervous before going on stage. He had never (say / tell) a joke in front of such a huge crowd. However, the host (speak / talk) warmly to him backstage.
explanation_ru: Словосочетание tell a joke означает «рассказать шутку»; с предлогом to в значении «поговорить» подходят spoke и talked.

prompt: We got lost near the train station in Madrid. Fortunately, my sister can (speak / talk) Spanish well enough to ask for directions. She (speak / talk) to a ticket inspector and found the right platform.
explanation_ru: Для владения иностранным языком используется глагол speak; для беседы с человеком подойдут spoke или talked.

prompt: The power went out during the storm last night. My aunt lit a candle and (say / tell) a story about her childhood on an island. She (say / tell) we used to have storms like that every autumn.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell a story переводится как «рассказать историю»; для передачи мысли без дополнения используется said.

prompt: We are planning a surprise party for Liam on Friday. You mustn't (say / tell) this secret to anyone at the office. If you (say / speak) a word, you will ruin everything.
explanation_ru: В английском говорят tell a secret (рассказать секрет) и say a word (проронить слово).

prompt: Ben claimed that humans only use ten percent of their brains. "Don't (speak / talk) nonsense," his biology teacher replied. "Scientists (say / tell) the whole brain is active every day."
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение talk nonsense означает «говорить ерунду»; в обобщённых утверждениях без дополнения ставится say.

prompt: We hurried to Gate 14 with our boarding passes. The departure board currently (say / tell) that our flight is delayed by an hour. An airline worker (say / tell) us to check the screen again at noon.
explanation_ru: О надписях на табло и вывесках говорят с помощью say (the board says); конструкция tell somebody to do something требует told.

prompt: At the summer street fair, we passed a colourful tent. An old woman offered to (say / tell) my fortune with a deck of cards. She (say / tell) that I would soon take a long journey.
explanation_ru: Выражение tell someone's fortune означает «гадать, предсказывать судьбу»; перед that без адресата используется said.

prompt: Both winter coats on the rack looked identical. I couldn't (say / tell) the two jackets apart until I checked the labels. The shop assistant (say / tell) me one was wool and the other was cotton.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол tell apart означает «различить»; при наличии косвенного дополнения me используется told.

prompt: I found a folded card on my desk this morning. The note (say / tell) "Staff meeting at 4 p.m.", so I cancelled my dentist appointment. Nobody had (say / tell) me about the schedule change earlier.
explanation_ru: Для передачи текста записки используется said; с дополнением me употребляется форма told.

prompt: The family gathered around the dinner table before eating. Every evening they pause to (say / tell) a prayer together. Afterwards, they (speak / talk) about how their day went.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание say a prayer означает «прочитать молитву»; с предлогом about для беседы подходят talk или speak.

prompt: The window in the classroom was broken during the break. Did the boy (say / tell) a lie when the headteacher questioned him? In the end, he (say / tell) the truth and apologized.
explanation_ru: Со словами a lie (ложь) и the truth (правда) всегда используется глагол tell.

prompt: We joined a guided walk through the national park. The ranger (say / tell) us not to leave the marked trail. He also (say / tell) that rare birds were nesting near the river.
explanation_ru: В модели tell someone not to do something ставится told; перед that без указания слушателя используется said.

prompt: I entered a radio contest last week and forgot about it. "You've won two concert tickets!" the DJ (say / tell) on air yesterday. He (say / tell) me to collect them at the studio.
explanation_ru: Прямая речь без адресата вводится глаголом said; конструкция tell someone to do something требует told.

prompt: My little nephew is learning how to use an analogue watch. He can now (say / tell) the time without any help. Yesterday he proudly (say / tell) everyone it was quarter past three.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell the time означает «определять время по часам»; с дополнением everyone ставится told.

prompt: I dialled the clinic's reception number to book a check-up. The woman on the line replied, "(Speak / Say)," when I asked for Dr Patel. Then she (speak / talk) clearly as she explained the available dates.
explanation_ru: В телефонном этикете фраза «Speaking» означает «У аппарата / Я слушаю»; для описания манеры речи подходят spoke или talked.

prompt: Our taxi was waiting outside the hotel entrance. Have you (say / tell) goodbye to the manager yet? Don't forget to (say / tell) thank you for the free breakfast.
explanation_ru: В формулах прощания и благодарности say goodbye и say thank you используется глагол say.

prompt: Tourists always stop to photograph the stone castle on the hill. This fortress is (say / tell) to hold hidden treasure in its cellars. Local guides often (speak / talk) about the legends connected to it.
explanation_ru: Конструкция is said to означает «говорят, что он...»; с предлогом about используются talk или speak.

prompt: Our swimming instructor hates when people waste pool time. At Tuesday's session, two swimmers were hanging on the lane rope (speak / talk) shop about their bicycles instead of doing laps. "Save it for the changing room," the instructor (say / tell). Then she (say / tell) them a story about an athlete who missed a medal by half a second.
explanation_ru: Идиома talk shop означает «говорить о работе/делах»; прямая речь вводится через said; в выражении tell someone a story нужен глагол told.

prompt: Tom accidentally spilled juice on his sister's notebook. Did you (say / tell) sorry for ruining her notes? You should also (say / tell) her that you will buy a new one.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение say sorry означает «извиниться»; при наличии дополнения her перед придаточным с that используется tell.

prompt: Workers found an ancient wooden bridge under the main square. It is (say / tell) that merchants used it five hundred years ago. Historians will (speak / talk) at the museum tonight about the discovery.
explanation_ru: Безличная конструкция It is said that переводится как «говорят, что...»; для публичного выступления подходят speak и talk.

prompt: During our hike in the mountains, we reached a wooden hut. The painted board above the door (say / tell) "Fresh Milk Here", but the place was completely empty. "Don't believe that board," a shepherd (say / tell) us. "The farmer moved to the valley two winters ago." We kept (speak / talk) about the ghost hut all afternoon.
explanation_ru: О тексте на табличке говорят с помощью said; при наличии дополнения us ставится told; после глагола keep используется форма talking.

prompt: Don't ___ back to the coach when he corrects your technique.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk back означает «дерзить, пререкаться».

prompt: Dr Kim has been invited to ___ at the international robotics conference next month.
explanation_ru: Для выступления с докладом или речью на мероприятии используется глагол speak (speak at a conference).

prompt: We had a noisy video call to plan the street food stall. "Could you ___ up? I can barely hear you," I asked Sam. Then I tried to talk him into making pancakes, and he finally agreed.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak up означает «говорить громче».

prompt: Could you ___ me through the setup steps for this new printer?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone through something означает «подробно объяснить кому-либо порядок действий».

prompt: You should always ___ thank you when a colleague covers your shift.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении say thank you используется глагол say.

answer: On the narrow mountain path, I looked down and froze. I was too frightened to say anything. My guide called out, "Keep moving!" I wanted to turn back, but he talked me out of it. At the viewpoint I finally admitted, "That was scary!"
accepted_answers: On the narrow mountain path, I looked down and froze. I was too frightened to say anything. My guide called out, "Keep moving!" I wanted to turn back, but he talked me out of it. At the viewpoint I finally admitted, "That was scary!"

prompt: The restaurant's five-star reviews say for themselves.
answer: The restaurant's five-star reviews speak for themselves.
accepted_answers: The restaurant's five-star reviews speak for themselves.
explanation_ru: Устойчивая идиома speak for themselves означает «говорят сами за себя».

prompt: I never say no to a warm cup of herbal tea.
answer: I never say no to a warm cup of herbal tea.
accepted_answers: I never say no to a warm cup of herbal tea.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: в выражении say no (отказываться) используется глагол say.

prompt: Our study group chat was full of questions about tomorrow's workshop. Nobody had told the new students which room to go to. I posted a notice that said, "Room 204, 10 a.m." Then Anna asked me to tell her through submitting the online form, since it was her first time.
answer: Our study group chat was full of questions about tomorrow's workshop. Nobody had told the new students which room to go to. I posted a notice that said, "Room 204, 10 a.m." Then Anna asked me to talk her through submitting the online form, since it was her first time.
accepted_answers: Our study group chat was full of questions about tomorrow's workshop. Nobody had told the new students which room to go to. I posted a notice that said, "Room 204, 10 a.m." Then Anna asked me to talk her through submitting the online form, since it was her first time.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «пошагово объяснить кому-то» звучит как talk someone through, а не tell.

prompt: You shouldn't tell ill of former colleagues during a job interview.
answer: You shouldn't speak ill of former colleagues during a job interview.
accepted_answers: You shouldn't speak ill of former colleagues during a job interview.
